description: This file is a shell script that performs system diagnostics and logging for memory, disk, CPU usage, and other system health indicators. It includes functions for checking disk space, memory usage, process memory, CPU load, and managing system components like SNMP and mount points. The script is used for self-healing and diagnostics in an embedded Linux-based system.

methods.name: logTmpFs
methods.description: Logs the temporary filesystem usage if it exceeds a threshold or if explicitly called with 'log', including usage details and mounted files.

methods.name: get_high_mem_processes
methods.description: Identifies high memory-consuming processes by parsing top command output and sends notifications with process details.
